title: Subtraction and Compare Word Problems Within 20
description: Solve subtraction and comparison word problems within 20, including take-from, take-apart, missing-number, more, and fewer stories.
learningFocus: Use objects, drawings, and equations to solve take-from, take-apart, missing start or change, and comparison word problems within 20.
adultGuidance: Read each story aloud and ask what is known, what is missing, and whether the answer should tell how many are left, a missing part, or how many more or fewer. Let your child use objects or draw when helpful, and accept any clear equation or explanation that matches the story.
